_comment: Known-failing MUST requirements for the official a2aproject/a2a-tck suite, measured at a2a-tck 5e6f37c (the pin in .github/workflows/official-tck.yml; nightly run 44981785033, job 137083647853, 2026-11-22, on 334fa45c, which graded upstream main at that commit).
